title: Tree-Scaled Runtime Ledger Bounds
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $P\subseteq[n]$, let $\delta\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\delta\le1/2$, and let a batch of the prescribed restricted sample size assign a free sign configuration and an output sign to each sample index. If $T_0=1$ and $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, then the tree call count $T_k$ times the Fourier scan work is at most $T_k$ times the Fourier scan runtime envelope. Also, $T_k$ times the polynomial learner's work on the reindexed polynomial sample batch is at most $T_k$ times the polynomial runtime envelope.
hypotheses_covered: the batch has the prescribed restricted sample size and consists of free assignments paired with signs
caveat: The supplied definitions do not give informal descriptions of the two runtime envelopes, so their mathematical content cannot be stated more explicitly without restating their defining formulas.
